reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets roughly doubled from ~600/month in Jun-Jul 2026 to ~1180-1260/month in Aug-Sep 2026 (E-05). Since the majority of disputed bills (1785 of 3025) are built from ACTUAL, successfully-received meter reads rather than ESTIMATED reads (E-01), the surge is caused primarily by errors in the billing import/computation step that converts accepted reads into bill amounts, not by read-source failure or estimate-substitution miscalibration.
